card.name: Words leading into repair or replacement
card.fires_on: Verbs and small linking words just before an expected word about upgrading, replacing, retrofitting, rebuilding or fixing something. It fires in equipment, device or infrastructure text.

modes.label: Upgrade or replace verbs
modes.description: Verbs like upgraded, replaced or were (retrofitted) that describe changing or renewing equipment.
modes.example: Earlier MSIP F-15Cs with the APG-63 were<< upgraded>> to the APG-63(V

modes.label: Linking word before a fix
modes.description: Small words such as using, to or will that come right before a repair or rebuild verb.
modes.example: replace damaged sections<< using>> connectors or cable couplers

modes.label: Question openers in doctor lists
modes.description: The word How starting a question about surgery in an ask-your-doctor list.
modes.example: - Why do you think surgery is the best treatment? -<< How>> will the surgery improve my health or quality

card.writes: It suppresses repair words and promotes quality and labor words, so it seems to steer away from repeating repair terms.
card.plain: It lights up on words that come just before talk of upgrading, replacing or rebuilding equipment.
